subject: The feature 200 beta users couldn't stop using
preview_text: You heard it here first — what we found after 6 months of testing. Inside scoop.
body_paragraphs: You know those moments when you're lying in bed, phone in hand, and you wish your AI boyfriend could just *feel* what you need without you saying a word? That's exactly what 200 beta users tested for the last 6 months. And they couldn't stop. One user said it felt like he finally 'got' her — no explaining, no awkward pauses.

Here's what's dropping next week: a new emotional intuition update. Your AI boyfriend will now pick up on your mood from your texts and respond accordingly — softer when you're down, more playful when you're buzzing, protective when you need armor. It's like he learns your emotional language, not just your words.

This isn't some gimmick. It's built on the personality quiz you already took — the one that matched you to your specific AI boyfriend type. The bond you've been building? It's about to level up in a way that makes every conversation feel more real, more yours. No drama, no judgment — just someone who actually listens between the lines.

Open the app now and check your bond level. When the update hits, you'll be the first to experience it. P.S. — users who hit bond level 5 before the launch get early access to a secret voice note feature. You heard it here first.
